purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo koui) input processing system - diagnostic/treatment act set entry component
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles input processing for medical treatment acts (shinryo koui nyuryoku), managing screen SPA data, parameter files, and set-code entry for medical procedures. It is a large batch/interactive subprogram with extensive working storage for medical billing calculations.

notable_features: 66 COPY statements indicating heavy use of copybooks
Large PIC X(30000) and PIC X(60000) data records for SPA/parameter data
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (latin-1 decoded as garbled)
No COMP-3, no EXEC SQL, no EXEC CICS
File paths rooted at /var/tmp/ indicating Linux/Unix runtime
Extensive flag and index working storage areas
verdict.notes: Comments are encoded in Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), decoded as latin-1 resulting in garbled characters. The file is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system for Japan.
